analysis_frozen.independent_raw_audit: Passed all 24 valid/stopped runs, 1272 correct samples, 20 failed frozen guards, and recorded fixture/cleanup gates.

complete_candidate_source: Ten full-head.patch files reconstruct all 49 canonical app files from each candidate real Git HEAD. Each patch includes inherited edits. source-reconstructions.json verifies file hashes and source_hash including git_head.
excluded_bytes: Compiled binaries/PDB, Git metadata/source bundles, source trees, build caches, tar archives and screenshots. Verbose binary-import and full-index listings have exact path/SHA256/size references; compact DLL summaries and fixture/build proof records remain.
included_evidence: New raw score/verdict/source/launch/cleanup records, native build producers and static checks, controls/seeds/build records, native diagnostics, external focused harnesses/proofs, failed attempts and prepared candidates.
portable_raw_reference_names: Run labels remain unique directory names; launch.json, launch.log, cleanup.log and score.stdout.log avoid repeating long labels. origin-map.json preserves each original path and byte hash in manifest origins.
source_patch_generation: git diff --binary HEAD -- <all 49 canonical files> from each owned candidate. A private temporary GIT_INDEX_FILE initialized with git read-tree HEAD avoids incomplete historical clone indexes; original metadata and source bytes remain unchanged.
